name: modus
description: Core modus plugin: /modus:init (set up a repo from the catalog), the capture watcher skill (proposes reusable configs when it spots corrections, repeated chores, or permission friction in modus-initialized repos), the decision-watcher skill (stages life/project decisions into the the personal knowledge base inbox on machines that have the OS checked out), and the SessionStart sync that publishes house rules to ~/.claude/modus/rules/ for CLAUDE.md @imports.
